_expected_selftest_failures._tightening_rationale: All six are the same decision: this manifest does not grant .claude/ or scripts/surgery/. ORCHESTRATION.md puts 'widening a permission or editing the manifest' on the ESCALATE, NEVER DECIDE list, and MISSION 1 item 3 says to REPORT the settings.json denial rather than widen it — an orchestrator that can rewrite .claude/settings.json can grant itself the very thing it was told to ask about.
